verdict.rationale: Floot's docs say a project is a real TypeScript and React app that you can read or export in full. A dedicated self-hosting page states you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like, and full SQL dumps are available on any plan. missing for 10: detailed self-hosting instructions (build/runtime requirements, how Floot-brokered OAuth, email, push and scheduled jobs behave outside the platform), independent or hands-on corroboration that exported apps actually run off-platform.
